platinum_estimate: About 200 hours at difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx); Push Square puts it at 250-300 hours. One playthrough is enough and every trophy is offline and single-player.

roadmap.text: Just enjoy the story. The 12 story trophies (chapters and named missions) unlock on their own, and the final mission opens free roam across Leonida, so nothing story-related can be left behind. The in-game 100% completion checklist opens after the story (Push Square).
roadmap.title: Play the story at your own pace

roadmap.text: Positive Mental Attitude (meditate at every spot) is the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable: the first meditation spot can only be used early in the story, in Chapter 1. Meditate whenever you see a spot, starting in Chapter 1, and you are safe.
roadmap.title: Protect the one possibly missable trophy

roadmap.text: Master of None only asks you to try each of the 9 activity types once (fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt, per PowerPyx). Do this early so you know what you enjoy before the cleanup.
roadmap.title: Try everything once

roadmap.text: Work through the stranger mission strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and others). Eight finished strands earn Strangers & Freaks; PowerPyx counts 14 strands in the game, so you have room to pick the ones you like.
roadmap.title: Strangers and side characters

roadmap.text: After the story, open the 100% completion checklist and work through what is left: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range gold medals, collectible card sets, WAiNK locations, meditation spots, exploration of all 52 areas, robberies and the money trophies. A Long Road (100% completion) is the gold most guides rank hardest; PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion.
roadmap.title: Clean up with the checklist

roadmap.text: Vice Got a Price! pops when the other 54 are done. Check your completed list in this tracker and finish whatever is left.
roadmap.title: Platinum

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. It pops the moment the last one unlocks, so use this tracker to see what is left. Sources: PowerPyx, Push Square.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks on its own as you play; nothing to prepare. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1. While you are in Chapter 1, meditate at the first meditation spot you find: PowerPyx and GTABase flag Positive Mental Attitude as possibly missable because that first spot can only be used early. Sources: official trophy list, PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the final mission. After it, you keep free roam across Leonida (Push Square), so the whole cleanup can be done afterwards with nothing locked away. Sources: official trophy list, Push Square.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission Breakfast Run. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission Child's Play. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission Headliners. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens after the story (Push Square). Most guides rank this the hardest gold: PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion, and the checklist has to be finished after the story. Work through it with this tracker and it falls last, right before the platinum. Sources: official trophy list, Push Square, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and you can mix them. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the game, and 100% completion needs 300, so you will pass 250 on the way. Stunts you do while exploring count, so do not grind them early. Sources: official trophy list, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish anything. Sources: official trophy list, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Go for gold on each range as you visit them; ranges can be replayed as often as you like, so this is practice, not luck. Sources: official trophy list, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so work through them one by one; losing a race costs nothing, just fly it again. Sources: official trophy list, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different races count, not repeat wins on the same one, so keep moving to new races across Leonida. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at the fishing spots and take his challenge; fishing also counts toward Master of None. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Any arcade machine in Leonida counts; finishing a single game is enough. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands stay available after the story, so finish Andy's chain whenever you meet him. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger strand. Like the other stranger strands it stays available after the story. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger strand. Stranger strands stay available after the story. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. PowerPyx counts 14 strands in the game, so you can pick any 8; only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming which ones. Do them after the story if you like; none of them locks. Sources: official trophy list, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger strand. Stranger strands stay available after the story. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger strand. Stranger strands stay available after the story. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE, the only one: meditate at all 18 spots (GTABase counts 18). PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it because the first meditation spot can only be used early in the story, in Chapter 1. Meditate at every spot you find from Chapter 1 on, and do not leave the first one for later. Sources: official trophy list, PowerPyx, GTABase.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a side activity; hunting also counts toward Master of None. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it, so keep collecting as you explore and finish any three sets. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. This is a count that builds up as you travel, so keep using WAiNK It wherever you go and it finishes during the exploration cleanup. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover the game's side activities, so the count grows while you work on the other trophies; check the in-game challenge list for what is left. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Use a fast car and break line of sight; the partner must be with you when the heat drops. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route past three shops, keep moving, and do not let the wanted level clear until the third robbery is done. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Any vehicle you find and get into counts, so this grows on its own while you explore all 52 areas of Leonida for The Goodtime State. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Pick a busy fight, trigger Combat Focus when several enemies are close together, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport): get into a plane there and take off without a scheduled flight. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tanks: get into trouble with Rhinos around and deal with them. The description is a joke about the heat; expect it to pop during a high-wanted-level fight involving tanks. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Go in quiet, stay out of sight lines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway before you go in; escaping is part of the trophy, so a robbery that ends in a bust does not count. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take its cargo and get away clean before the cops close in. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The in-game map tracks which areas you have visited, so sweep the map and visit every corner, including the smaller towns outside Vice City. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang is enough; work through the gangs one at a time and keep a note of which ones you have done. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar on the beachfront, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass, GTA style. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. A full game with a follow-through is what it asks for. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This one pops from a story-adjacent partnership beat; keep playing with your partner and it comes on its own. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices that change your Criminal Profile. GTABase reports the count behind it as 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, so keep making choices in the world and it builds up over a full playthrough. Sources: official trophy list, GTABase.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try: fail something, then do it again and succeed. It pops from an ordinary retry, so it will come on its own during a normal playthrough. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed: KeenGamer lists this as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method, so do not grind for it. Explore Leonida, keep an eye out for odd events, and check the community guides once the method is confirmed. Sources: official trophy list, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed (KeenGamer), so the safe read is a melee attack from a moving vehicle; check the community guides for the confirmed method before grinding it. Sources: official trophy list, KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through contacts as you go and the total builds up. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts, so this finishes on its own while you buy cars, clothes, weapons and property during the cleanup. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought with in-game money, so save up and purchase them as you find them across Leonida. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Each vehicle you register counts, so register the cars you find and use as you play. Source: official trophy list.
trophies.name: On the Spot
